title: He Bought a Used Uniform and Took Over a Town #history #shorts
description:
In 1906 a 57-year-old shoemaker, just out of prison, put on a captain's uniform he had bought piece by piece from junk shops. Real soldiers followed his orders, and he arrested the mayor of Köpenick.

The dialogue lines are dramatized from the reported orders. The scenes are an animated dramatization.
